meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: 把一个产品网址、粘贴的文案或简报做成产品发布/宣传视频:先抓取网址素材,再定设计、写分镜与脚本,逐帧生成画面,最后渲染成 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当你想宣传某个产品、给出商业网址,或要求做产品视频等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个产品页做成一条发布宣传视频
say.note: 会先抓取该网址的内容再开始制作

say.text: 给我这个网址做一个官网导览展示视频
say.note: 会按「展示原貌」的方式处理截图

say.text: 这是我写好的产品介绍文案,做成宣传片
say.note: 会以这段文案为核心生成分镜与旁白

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: captures the site's assets, sets up a design system, writes a storyboard and script, generates frames, and renders the final mp4 via HyperFrames.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, shares a commercial URL, or asks for a promo or site tour. Default for any commercial URL.

say_en.text: Turn this product page into a launch video
say_en.note: Captures the URL and starts the workflow

say_en.text: Make a site tour video for this website
say_en.note: Handled as show-it-as-is with real screenshots

say_en.text: Here is my script, make a promo video from it
say_en.note: Saves the script verbatim and builds the storyboard around it
